plan.notes: Official Clemson Undergraduate Catalog term-by-term plan for Geology, BS (2022-2023 Undergraduate Catalog, archived edition). Transcribed verbatim from the catalog program page. Semester credit sums reconcile exactly to the declared Total Credits: 126 (15+17+16+15+15+16+6+13+13). The summer 'Field Experience' semester appears between junior spring and senior fall in the catalog. Requirement slots: STEM Requirement (footnote 2: 25 credits, level caps, prefix exclusions; distributed 3+7+3+6+6 across semesters); Geology Requirement (footnote 4: 15 credits from GEOL 3160/3180/4030/4050/4090/4150/4210/4820; distributed 7+4+4); Quantitative Science (footnote 3: 6 credits, Group I or Group I+II); Field Experience (footnote 5: GEOL 4750, other six-credit field camp, or GEOL 2750 plus a three-credit field course); General Education (footnote 1: three credits must also satisfy the SC REACH Act; Global Challenges cannot be fulfilled by transfer courses). The catalog also offers Environmental Science and Hydrogeology concentrations with more structured pathways; this seed follows the general track. The catalog term plan does not list per-course prerequisites, so prereq arrays are empty.
